Descartes and the measured readiness-profile run agree that router source saturation is not the root fix target. The control_snapshot readiness-profile patch moved the sample from generic control_plane_pressure to available critical-system spread evidence: all four critical tables are visible but stuck at 2/3 distinct ready nodes, while priority-recovery planning on sql_transactions waits on local_serve_readiness with cluster_member_unhealthy/control_plane_write_unhealthy and operationCreationRequired=false. Next owner boundary is priority recovery planning/spread, not admin repair or router limits.
rulesOut: Do not increase target-fallback router source caps or continue patching admin discovery repair as the current blocker; focus on priority recovery planning for the remaining 2/3 critical-system spread gap.

mechanism: stale cache-visible priority recovery replica_operations rows are treated as live operation contexts, so the planning gate reports operationCreationRequired=false after the failed/stale r4 attempt while critical-system spread remains open
intervention: Filter stale in-flight replica_operations rows out of sync priority-recovery follow-up operation contexts before rebuilding the operation-creation planning snapshot.
expectedMovement: critical_system_spread_open should no longer be paired with priority-recovery planning diagnostics that show operationCreationRequired=false solely because stale cache-visible replace progress exists; the run should either create fresh recovery work or expose the next activation/transport blocker.
negativeResultMeans: If operationCreationRequired remains false with stale in-flight operation rows and an open spread gap, the missing signal is not stale operation context filtering; inspect priorityPartitionSummary/publication recovery projection as the source of the false closure.
discriminator: Focused stale-planning test flips only stale in-flight replace progress to operationCreationRequired=true while preserving the live replace no-duplicate invariant, followed by the rolling-restart measured attempt.

hypothesis: Filter stale priority-recovery replica operation rows out of sync planning operation contexts so failed/stale recovery progress cannot suppress fresh operation creation for an open critical spread gap.
expectedMovement: critical_system_spread_open should no longer be paired with priority-recovery planning diagnostics that show operationCreationRequired=false because stale cache-visible replace progress exists; the run should either create fresh recovery work, close the spread gap, or expose the next activation/transport blocker.
